DISHA was formed to enhance holistic alignment between India and Saudi Arabia. It was officially inaugurated on 23 June 2021, with Padma Shri Awardee Smt. Nouf Al Marwaai, founder of the Arab Yoga Foundation and President of the Saudi Yoga Committee, launching the organisation. Shri Y. Sabir, Deputy Consul General of India, Jeddah, attended as Chief Guest. DISHA's Regional Committees were announced on 27 October 2021 at its first National Conference.

Privacy: body (## = heading, - = bullet, {email} = contact email)

This policy explains what personal information DISHA collects when you apply for membership or raise a support request, why we collect it and how it is protected.
## Information we collect Through the membership application form we collect the details on DISHA's paper application: your name, gender, date of birth, nationality, contact numbers and email, blood group (optional), education and occupation, your city and region in Saudi Arabia, your Iqama and passport numbers, your permanent address in India, two emergency contacts, an optional passport-size photograph, and your declaration of consent. We ask only for what membership administration needs.
## How we use it - To review your application, create your membership record and issue your digital ID card. - To contact you about DISHA activities, programmes and official communication. - To contact your emergency contacts if needed during activities.
## Sensitive identity details Iqama and passport numbers are visible only to DISHA managers authorised to approve memberships. They are never shown on your ID card or in the card's QR code, which confirms membership status only.
## Storage and access Applications are stored in DISHA's secure membership system and are accessible only to authorised DISHA office bearers and staff. Data is sent over encrypted connections. We do not sell your information.
## Sharing We do not share your personal information with third parties except where required by law.
## Your choices You may ask to see, correct or delete your information, or withdraw your consent to be contacted, by emailing {email} and quoting your application number.
## Contact Questions about this policy: {email}.
